headline: Senior Cybersecurity Governance & Incident Response Specialist
summary: Accomplished security professional with over 8 years of experience in enterprise security governance, risk compliance, and incident response. Proven track record of fortifying infrastructure within the Nepali financial and telecommunications sectors. Expertise in ISO 27001 implementation, regulatory auditing, and advanced threat hunting. Dedicated to building resilient security postures through strategic policy development and hands-on technical remediation.

experiences.title: Information Security Manager
description: Lead the enterprise security governance framework, ensuring compliance with NRB (Nepal Rastra Bank) directives.
Coordinate annual ISO 27001 audits and manage remediation plans for identified vulnerabilities.
Oversee a team of security analysts during high-pressure incident response scenarios including banking system intrusion attempts.
Develop and enforce information security policies across all bank branches and digital service channels.

experiences.title: Cybersecurity Analyst
description: Monitored network traffic for malicious activity within the core telecom infrastructure.
Conducted routine vulnerability assessments on internal applications and web services.
Assisted in the deployment of SIEM solutions to improve threat visibility.
Participated in the incident response team to mitigate DDoS attacks and unauthorized access attempts.

experiences.title: Junior Security Engineer
description: Provided technical support for SIEM log management and alert correlation.
Assisted in writing custom parsing rules for various network security appliances.
